  Get_Current_Time:
    title: Get Current Time
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Captures the current timestamp for recording when the observable was last seen
    on-success:
    - Create_TI_Record_Variables: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      now:
        title: Now
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: dateParseBasic
            inputs:
            - Current Time
            - 
            - 
            - 
            - 
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $dateParseBasic('Current Time',null,null,null,null)
          data: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: now
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Create_TI_Record_Variables:
    title: Create TI Record Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initializes a variable to store the observable value for use throughout the flow
    on-success:
    - Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Observable_Value
      value: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Observable.observable_value }'
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 6007e633-326a-48f8-af1a-005b05f33864
    outputSchemaReferenceId: fe4d2c50-b5f9-456b-8217-971e4e73c309
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Parallel:
    title: Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: >
      Executes conditional file processing in parallel before creating the threat intelligence record
    on-success:
    - Upsert_Threat_Intelligence_Record: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - If_Observable_Type_File
    actions:
      If_Observable_Type_File:
        title: If Observable Type = File
        type: conditional
        description: >
          Checks if the observable is a file type to determine if hash extraction is needed
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        conditions:
        - action: Get_SHA256_Hash
          condition:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $inputs.Observable.observable_type
              - $:eq: file
              - ignoreCase: false
        else: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: fa597dd6-27c1-4daa-9992-45e0ff0daff1
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Get_SHA256_Hash:
        title: Get SHA256 Hash
        type: connector
        description: >
          Computes the SHA256 hash of the file attachment for unique identification
        on-success:
        - Update_Observable_Value: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: turbine_attachment.hash
        inputs:
          attachment:
            $:ref: $inputs.Observable.observable_file
          algorithm: SHA256
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
      Update_Observable_Value:
        title: Update Observable Value
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Updates the observable value variable to include the file hash prefix and computed SHA256 value
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Observable_Value
          operation:
            type: set
            value: 'file:{ $:ref: $actions.Get_SHA256_Hash.result.hash }'
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 7577c3af-50ff-404f-8cab-3563c0964cf9
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 1e22e52f-84f2-4720-9bdc-2fddf7a4ae4d
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Upsert_Threat_Intelligence_Record:
    title: Upsert Threat Intelligence Record
    type: recordAction
    description: >
      Creates or updates a threat intelligence record with observable details, type, file attachment, and last seen timestamp
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
      applicationId: aGfR2rPsFvQq4lBU_
      keyFieldKey: observable
      keyFieldValue: '{ $:ref: $variables.Observable_Value }'
      patchValues:
        observable: '{ $:ref: $variables.Observable_Value }'
        observable-type: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Observable.observable_type }'
        observable-file:
          $:ref: $inputs.Observable.observable_file
        last-seen: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Current_Time.result.now }'
      restrictions:
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
      applicationName: ""
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
    recordActionType: upsert
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 51fdecc2-7fed-4376-a875-fa895ee0b8bd
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
meta: {}
